_notes: One-liner flavor text per real weapon_type (see data/items/weapon_types.json), used for Valley of Trials quest reward weapon choices. Written from the perspective of an everyday human from Earth transported into this world - Kyle's real specification, this session. Only weapon_types that actually exist in the game's data are mapped; bow/crossbow/gun/polearm/tome/orb aren't real weapon_types yet, held in reserve for whenever that art/data exists.

weapon_flavor_text.sword_1h: You've never swung a blade before, but in your hands, this feels right.
weapon_flavor_text.sword_2h: In movie props this would weigh forty pounds, but here you lift it like a feather.
weapon_flavor_text.dagger: Smaller than a kitchen knife, yet infinitely more dangerous.
weapon_flavor_text.mace_1h: Back home this was a museum exhibit; here, it's a problem solver.
weapon_flavor_text.mace_2h: You used to struggle with heavy groceries - now you're swinging a cinder block on a stick.
weapon_flavor_text.axe_1h: You've only ever used one of these on firewood, but targets are targets.
weapon_flavor_text.axe_2h: It lacks the clean balance of a golf club, but it certainly gets the message across.
weapon_flavor_text.fist_weapon: Wolverine made it look easy, but feeling the weight on your knuckles is a whole different story.
weapon_flavor_text.wand: You used to think these were just plastic toys at theme parks, until spark came out the tip.
weapon_flavor_text.staff: Back home magic didn't exist, but now you harness it freely.
weapon_flavor_text.shield: A car door wouldn't stop what's out there, but this solid piece of metal just might.
weapon_flavor_text.thrown: You've thrown a baseball. This is somehow both easier and much more likely to draw blood.
weapon_flavor_text.totem: It hums faintly in your hand, like it's waiting for you to understand something you don't yet.
